description: Record payment on an issued invoice: DR cash / CR ACCOUNTS_RECEIVABLE, plus CR SALES_TAX_PAYABLE for any tax collected on top; advances issued -> paid.

cash_account.description: Where the money landed. Omit for CASH (handed over, deposited). A processor collection names its in-transit account, e.g. CASH_IN_TRANSIT_STRIPE.

tax.description: Sales tax collected on top of the invoice total, if any (a processor's calculation). Posted to SALES_TAX_PAYABLE; omit when none.
